description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various categories across a dataset, with each slice representing a different topic and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment, colored in a dark blue shade, corresponds to AI/NLP Research, accounting for 24.3% of the total. The second-largest category is Econ. & Fin., shown in a teal color, making up 18.4%. Other notable categories include Daily Life (7.1%, light blue), History (8.2%, yellowish-brown), and Science (6.7%, dark green), each represented by distinct colors and labeled with their respective percentages. Smaller segments include Med & Health (6.7%, olive green), Pet & Animal (5.5%, light brown), Law (5.1%, reddish-brown), Business (5.9%, red), Geography (2.7%, light green), Math (1.2%, very dark green), and Game&Anime (8.2%, orange). The chart uses labels connected by lines to indicate each category and its percentage, with the slices arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top right. The visual representation clearly highlights the dominance of AI/NLP Research and Econ. & Fin. in the dataset.
